mechanics.title: Chunk caching
mechanics.description: Chunks the server sends are stored in .minecraft/.bobby and displayed as 'fake chunks' beyond the server's view distance. Fake chunks can be tinted darker (config) and block entities in them are not loaded by default.

mechanics.title: Fallback world
mechanics.description: A single-player world whose folder is renamed 'bobby-fallback' is used to fill in chunks the server never sent.

mechanics.title: Singleplayer
mechanics.description: Active in singleplayer only if the 'Singleplayer Server View Distance' option is set above 0.

qol: Far-away terrain visible on servers with low view distance
Config reloads automatically; screen available with Mod Menu and Cloth Config
getting_started: Raise render distance in video settings; the max can be extended with Sodium (config option).
editor_notes: Only previously visited areas can appear beyond server view distance.
name: Bobby
summary: Lets you set render distance higher than the server's view-distance by caching chunks the server has sent and showing them again later when they are out of range.
